start: ^I saw Him on the beach. We had fished all night and caught nothing. Then He stood there — alive. He spoke to me about love. Three times He asked, and three times I answered.
questions: ^'Do you love me more than these?' He asked. I said yes. 'Do you love me?' Again, I said yes. 'Do you love me?' A third time — my heart broke. The threefold question for my threefold denial.
commission: ^'Simon, son of John, do you love me?' Yes, Lord. 'Feed my lambs.' Again — 'Do you love me?' Yes, Lord. 'Feed my sheep.' The third time — 'Lord, you know all things. You know that I love you.' 'Feed my sheep.'
closing: ^He forgave me. Not with words of reproach, but with a calling. 'Follow me.' I am the rock that was shattered and made whole. The church would be built on this restored love.
